title: Every Escape Freed One Prisoner by Erasing a Family | ECHO//30 Ep. 10
description:
Imran reveals why he stopped trying to escape the Missing Hour: every rescue erased another innocent family in Navapur. Tara refuses to accept that no fair solution exists—but Kavi secretly follows a route sent by his future voice.

The route leads to the temporal core, where the Red Door should reopen without a human exchange. Instead, Byte plays an order recorded by an older Kavi. The Door seals into black metal, and Tara finally sees the message Kavi hid from her.

scenes.image_prompt: Imran explains the human cost of earlier escape attempts beside memorial glass where paired family silhouettes fade into dust; Tara, Kavi and Mira react in horror.
scenes.text: Imran revealed that every escape attempt freed one prisoner by erasing an innocent family in Navapur. He had stopped trying.

scenes.image_prompt: Intimate Tara and Imran confrontation connected by their matching red cable; Tara argues for a fair exchange while Imran rejects the idea of a fair victim.
scenes.text: Tara insisted they could find a fair exchange. Imran answered that a fair victim was still a victim.

scenes.image_prompt: Kavi conceals a normal-sized cracked phone projecting an abstract route toward the temporal core while Tara watches suspiciously and Imran and Mira study a map.
scenes.text: Kavi's phone received a route from his future voice to the station's temporal core. He hid the sender from Tara.

scenes.image_prompt: Mira drives an old maintenance train through concentric time machinery toward a cyan core; Kavi, Tara and Imran brace inside the moving cabin.
scenes.text: Mira guided them onto a maintenance train, believing the core could reopen the Red Door without trading a human life.

scenes.image_prompt: Outside the Missing Hour, Rhea aims her brass key at the vanished Door while Byte refuses; a red voiceprint lock with Kavi's glasses emblem blocks her.
scenes.text: Outside the Missing Hour, Rhea ordered Byte to release the lock. Byte said Kavi's own voiceprint blocked her command.

scenes.image_prompt: Byte involuntarily plays a stored future voice waveform that forces a holographic lock shut; Rhea lowers her key in betrayal and Byte looks ashamed.
scenes.text: Then Byte played a stored order from an older Kavi: seal the Door after we cross.

scenes.image_prompt: The maintenance train faces one doorway transforming from red energy on its left half into locked black metal on its right half as all four travelers react.
scenes.text: The train reached a blank tunnel wall. A red doorway appeared, then hardened into impenetrable black metal.

scenes.image_prompt: Kavi holds one slim vertical phone showing Byte linked to a lock; Tara sees the secret and pulls her red headphone cable away while Mira and Imran watch.
scenes.text: Kavi received the matching message. Byte did exactly what I asked. Tara saw the screen—and pulled her red cable away.
